title: EOCRFDEWRDM7W - EOCR-FDE digital over current relay with load alert, 0.5–60 A, 220 V AC
range_short_desc: Digital over-current relay with load alerting
description: EOCR-FDE digital over current relay with a load-alerting element, separate-display (remote panel) type. Protects against over-current, under-current, phase loss, phase unbalance, phase reversal and locked rotor, with a digital ammeter and trip-cause indication. This variant: current range 0.5–60 A, power supply 220 V AC. Output is a 2-SPST overload contact (95-96, 97-98) plus an alert relay (07-08).

feature_groups.title: Main Feature
items: Selectable trip time characteristics (inverse or definite)
Independently adjustable starting trip delay (D-TIME) and trip time (O-TIME)

specs.group: This variant (as marked on the box)

rows: Control voltage (family) : 24 V AC/DC, 110 V AC ±15 %, 220 V AC ±15 %
Contact rating : 3 A / 250 V AC resistive
An external CT should be used when the inverse curve (tc In setting) is applied above 10 A.
